description: Create a folder to organize diagrams. Pass `name`, and optionally `parentId` (a folder id from list_folders) to nest it; null or omitted creates it at the root. Returns the new { id, name, parentId }; use the returned id as `folderId` when creating or moving a diagram. Requires the `write` capability.

name.description: human-readable folder name shown in the workspace

parentId.description: parent folder id from list_folders; null or omitted = create at the root.

name: create_folder
title: Create a folder
